Partly built

Food and beverage owner, revenue goal

You will set a revenue goal and your assistant will run the plan, hand steps to your salespeople and report the result from your own sheet.

Partly built. Some of the steps below exist today and the rest are still to come. The lists at the bottom show which.

How it runs

  1. GoalYou no tool neededSet the goal for the company: revenue up by a stated amount in a stated window.
  2. PlanYour assistant via model, connected toolResearches, reads the CRM and the sheet, and writes a plan with named steps.
  3. PlanTwo salespeople via person inside, by organisation chainEach gets a step with a due date and a priority.
  4. ProposalEach salesperson's assistant via modelDrafts the follow-up as a proposal; the salesperson approves it.
  5. ReceiptThe sheet via connected dataThe key result is read from the sheet and shown on your Identity page.
What you get
Starts withA company goal
StatusPartly built
A plan, who did each step, the key result read from your sheet, and the cost.

What it keeps to

  • Another workspace sees nothing of this plan.
  • A draft is a proposal; nothing is sent without approval.
  • Spending stops climbing before it hits the budget.
